tools.name: rotacloud_list_accounts
tools.description: The RotaCloud account(s) this API key belongs to: name, plan, time zone, employee count. GET /accounts.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_users
tools.description: List employees (users) with their level, roles, locations, contact details and pay settings. Use it to map user ids in shifts, leave and attendance to names. GET /users.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_user
tools.description: One employee by id. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_locations
tools.description: List locations (sites/branches) with address, time zone and managers. GET /locations.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_roles
tools.description: List job roles (positions) with colour, default break and pay rate. GET /roles.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_shifts
tools.description: List rota shifts in a time range: start/end times (Unix seconds), break, assigned user (null = open shift), location, role, notes, published and acknowledged state. Filter by users, locations, roles, open or published. GET /shifts.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_shift
tools.description: One shift by id. GET /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_swap_requests
tools.description: List shift swap requests with their status, the shifts and the users involved. GET /swap_requests.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_day_notes
tools.description: List day notes (notices pinned to rota dates, e.g. events or deliveries), optionally for one location. GET /day_notes.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_attendance
tools.description: List time & attendance records (clock-in/out times, breaks, minutes late, hours, approval state) in a time range. GET /attendance.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_clocked_in
tools.description: Who is clocked in right now: user, location, role, clock-in time, minutes late and break state. GET /users_clocked_in.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_leave
tools.description: List booked leave (holiday, sickness, etc.) with type, user, dates, hours and status. Filter by date range or leave year, users and leave types; pending/denied/expired requests are excluded unless asked for. GET /leave.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_leave_requests
tools.description: List leave requests awaiting a decision (and past ones): user, leave type, dates, half days, the employee's message. GET /leave_requests.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_leave_request
tools.description: One leave request by id, with the per-day breakdown. GET /leave_requests/{id}.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_leave_types
tools.description: List leave types (Holiday, Sickness, Unpaid, ...) with id, short name and whether employees can request them. GET /leave_types.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_holiday_allowances
tools.description: Every employee's holiday allowance for a leave year (default and custom allowance, unit, carried over). GET /holiday_allowances/{year}.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_availability
tools.description: Employees' availability per date in a range (available / unavailable times). GET /availability.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_days_off
tools.description: Employees' scheduled days off per date in a range. GET /days_off.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_pay_periods
tools.description: List pay periods overlapping a date range (id, name, start/end date, locked). GET /pay_periods.

tools.name: rotacloud_get_payroll
tools.description: Payroll for one pay period, per employee: pay settings, attendance worked, paid/unpaid leave, overtime and pay totals. Contains pay data. GET /pay_periods/{id}/payroll.

tools.name: rotacloud_create_shift
tools.description: WRITE: create a shift on the rota. Leave user_id out for an open shift. Unpublished by default (employees see it once published). POST /shifts.

tools.name: rotacloud_update_shift
tools.description: WRITE: change a shift's times, assignee, location, role, break, notes or published state. Only the fields you pass change. POST /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: rotacloud_publish_shifts
tools.description: WRITE: publish shifts so the assigned employees see them (and get notified). POST /shifts_published.

tools.name: rotacloud_create_leave_request
tools.description: WRITE: submit a leave request on behalf of an employee (sent as that user, for a manager to approve). POST /leave_requests with the User header.

tools.name: rotacloud_approve_leave_request
tools.description: WRITE: approve a pending leave request (it becomes booked leave and the employee is notified). POST /leave_requests/{id}/approve.

tools.name: rotacloud_deny_leave_request
tools.description: WRITE: deny a pending leave request (the employee is notified). POST /leave_requests/{id}/deny.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rotacloud_list_leave_requests, rotacloud_create_shift, rotacloud_publish_shifts · Private data: rotacloud_list_accounts, rotacloud_list_users, rotacloud_list_attendance · Public sink: rotacloud_create_shift, rotacloud_update_shift, rotacloud_publish_shifts, rotacloud_create_leave_request, rotacloud_approve_leave_request, rotacloud_deny_leave_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rotacloud_list_leave_requests, rotacloud_create_shift, rotacloud_publish_shifts · Private data: rotacloud_list_accounts, rotacloud_list_users, rotacloud_list_attendance · Public sink: rotacloud_create_shift, rotacloud_update_shift, rotacloud_publish_shifts, rotacloud_create_leave_request, rotacloud_approve_leave_request, rotacloud_deny_leave_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
